numbering: TV episodes numbered 1-24; the one-hour Winter Arc special (December 2025) is unnumbered.

arcs.name: Undead and Unluck
arcs.summary: Fuuko, whose touch brings disaster on anyone, meets Andy, an unkillable man who wants her to give him a real death. Their meeting pulls them into the Union, a secret organization of ability-holders called Negators.
events: Andy and Fuuko team up and are hunted by Union agents.
They learn of the Union, its Roundtable seats and the rule-setting being called God.
In Russia the pair defeats Gina, whose ability freezes things in place.

arcs.name: Spoil
arcs.summary: As new Union members, Andy and Fuuko are sent on their first quest from the talking book Apocalypse: capturing the UMA Spoil in Nevada.
events: Spoil turns a whole town's people into zombies.
Andy's violent alter ego Victor surfaces and overpowers everyone.
A failed quest triggers a penalty that adds the new UMA Galaxy to the world.

arcs.name: Under and the Auction
arcs.summary: The team heads to Rio to win back the artifact Unrepair at a black-market auction and runs into Under, a rival group hunting Negators.
events: Andy and Fuuko protect the auctioned Negator boy Chikara from hunters.
Andy clashes with Under's Rip, and Tatiana's backstory is revealed.
Chikara decides to join the Union.

arcs.name: Billy's Betrayal
arcs.summary: A revolt from inside the Roundtable throws the Union into chaos.
events: The Union's leader Billy betrays the Roundtable and abducts its members.
Juiz reveals that God has destroyed and remade the world in repeating loops.

arcs.name: Autumn
arcs.summary: A manga that mirrors real past events leads the team to its author and to the UMA Autumn.
events: Fuuko meets the manga's author, Anno Un, who has her own Negator ability.
Fuuko's spirit travels into Andy's past and learns where his Undead ability came from.
Andy unlocks his new Deadline technique.
Autumn is captured, and Rip agrees to work with Andy and Fuuko.

arcs.name: Winter Arc
arcs.summary: A one-hour special that continues the story after the TV season, ahead of an announced second season.
events: The special picks up the Union's fight after the Autumn quest.
Its broadcast doubled as the lead-in to the second season, announced the same day.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga.
